name: SERV
features: hotel service-specific menus and catalog items
hotel service menu filtering for guests
spoken voice alerts for new orders and service requests
light and dark theme selector with device persistence
business hero cover image upload for restaurants hotels and event centres
hero image displayed at top of customer QR landing page
optional event-specific hero image with business hero fallback
native Android Firebase FCM notification delivery with server-side OAuth service account
validation: PHP syntax lint completed for all PHP files
QR image endpoint moved outside protected /app/ path
Customer cart script corrected
Order status transition guard added
Duplicate customer submissions guarded by client token
Live staff dashboard polling with sound/browser notification permission
Initial notification cursor prevents replaying old alerts
Customer order idempotency prevents duplicate form resubmissions; new order is explicit
Hotel menu categories and items can be assigned to individual hotel services
Customer hotel service hub filters orderable items by selected service
Staff alerts support spoken announcements using browser SpeechSynthesis
Theme selector available in Settings > Appearance with persistent light/dark mode
Hero uploads validated for JPG PNG WebP with size and dimension limits
QR customer pages render the configured business hero image
Event QR pages render event hero first and business hero as fallback
Firebase FCM service-account loader and HTTP v1 sender added
FCM device-token registration endpoint added
Notification delivery switched from OneSignal to Firebase FCM
Android native FCM service and token bridge added
FCM payload converted to high-priority data-only delivery for native voice handling
GitHub Actions Android APK workflow added
Native Android voice toggle and test control added
notes: Full background Web Push delivery requires a VAPID/Web Push sender configuration.
QR image generation uses the QR Server image service through qr-image.php. The encoded destination is always SERV q.php.
Voice announcements require the staff dashboard to be open and voice/audio permission to have been unlocked by a user gesture; OS-level background voice playback is not guaranteed by mobile browsers.
Firebase service account must be uploaded separately to storage/firebase-service-account.json and must never be committed to GitHub or included in the Android APK.
Android notification channels are serv_orders, serv_requests and serv_general; the Android app must create these channels before production notification testing.
GitHub Actions requires the GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON repository secret containing the Firebase Android app configuration.
The Android release APK is unsigned until a release keystore is configured.
release: SERV domain + direct Firebase FCM deployment
